zh: 和别人一起玩的几种办法。这张页面没有自己的服务器：要给别人看的东西，由你自己贴到 GitHub 上；实时房间走公共的中继。不联网的时候，自己玩的部分照样能用。
en: Ways to play with other people. This page has no server of its own: anything you want others to see, you post to GitHub yourself, and live rooms go through public relays. Without a network connection, everything you play on your own still works.

zh: ：给中学生的入口。先亲手打一局，再学编程和算法的基本想法，最后自己写一条规则（中文）。
en: : an entry point for secondary-school students. Play an episode by hand first, then learn the basic ideas of programming and algorithms, then write a rule of your own (in Chinese).

zh: 打开大厅（每日一局、每日一题、实时房间、十项全能、规则同场、世界工坊）
en: Open the lobby (daily episode, daily challenge, live rooms, decathlon, rule arena, world workshop)

zh: 大厅 lobby 一起 多人 联机 社区 排行 榜
en: lobby together multiplayer online community ranking leaderboard board

zh: ：在浏览器里做机器学习实验。表格、时间序列、图像与格点、科研玩具四类任务，几十种内置算法，也可以让 AI 写；学习曲线、排行榜与配对检验、模型内部和训练过程的动画（中文）。
en: : machine-learning experiments in the browser. Four kinds of task (tabular data, time series, images and lattices, research toy problems), dozens of built-in algorithms, or have an AI write one; learning curves, a leaderboard with paired tests, model internals and animated replays of training (in Chinese).
